card.name: And after COX-2 selective in NSAID warning
card.fires_on: The word "and" in the NSAID cardiovascular warning phrase "COX-2 selective and nonselective NSAIDs". Weakly also "to" in "belonging to the calcium channel blockers".

modes.description: "to" after "belonging" just before a drug class name.
